slides.intent: Explain why the rebuild mattered — problem, then solution

placeholder.title: Why We Rebuilt
placeholder.body: Our old site could not keep pace — slow pages, buried pricing, and a mobile experience that lost half our visitors. The new Atlas site puts clarity first: faster loads, honest messaging, and paths that match how teams actually buy.

placeholder.title: Built for the Desktop
placeholder.body: Spacious layouts, rich product storytelling, and documentation that scales with complex evaluations — all optimized for the screen where decisions get made.
